answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 45496 Country: India Title: masla of iddat Question: Today that is on 6th May 2013 I got talaq on mutual understanding. I do not have any physical relation with my husband from the day of marriage till the day of talaq and my husband was totally alcoholic (sharab) and also I am living separately from my husband from 27 October 2012 till the day of talaq. Alhamdulillah I have my both parents to take care but I want to do my job for my future security. Please guide me in the light of the holy Quran in such situation does it necessary to complete iddah or I can do my job or if there is any relaxation in this case. Please help me out. My marriage date -27 January2012 Living separately from-27 October 2012 Date of talaq -6th May 2013 Answer ID: 45496 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 881/881/M=1434) If you met your husband in privacy and then talaq took place, then iddah is wajib on you. It is not correct to go out of home during iddah period for job. But if you did not meet your husband in privacy after nikah, then in this case there is no iddah on you. But it is not clear what is the problem that you do a job? And what type of job do you want to do? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
